title: Any plugin s that allow the us to make the actors as enemies?

posts.author: Murr_Murri
posts.body:
Hi I'm a rookie of RPG Maker and just started. I have only used VisuStella's plugin and I barely understand that. But right now I'm focusing on trying to have a cutscene where one of my actors wants to spar with another one of my actors. But I realized that it wasn't possible.
My battle system is side view.
If anyone got any tips. Please let me know

posts.author: Solar_Flare
posts.body:
The "official" way is to make an enemy version of your actor. You'd probably want to use the plugin that allows using sideview actor animations on enemies as well (I don't know what it's called but there's likely one in the VisuStella collection).
I suspect a plugin that allows directly putting actors into an enemy troop wouldn't be too complicated, as most of the game's mechanics are set up to treat actors and enemies identically. I don't know of any that do this though.
